changeinfo.changes:
Liberty Day is finally here once again! New ways of spreading managed democracy, a swifter way of changing gear between missions and much more. Liberty for all!
New content:
• Added Proving Grounds. A new game mode where Helldivers can hone their skills by completing unique replayable challenges.
• Added Favorite Loadouts.
• Added Random Loadouts.
Fixed:
• City Defend Events now have difficulty 15 missions available as well.
• Fixed an issue causing the M-25 'Rumbler' to get infinite ammo from forced quick reloads.
Changed:
• It is now possible to skip the Galactic War Summary.
• The AT-47 Anti-Tank Emplacement shells now do damage to the Emplacement if firing at close range targets.
• AD-289 'Angel' and AD-334 'Guard Dog' will return to backpack to rearm if left idle for a while.
• Increased damage and fire rate for AC-22 'Dum-Dum'.
• FLAM-40 'Incinerator' now leaves swaths of fire in its wake.
• Strong Arm now increases melee damage as well.

New content:
• Added three new difficulties:
13 - An Exercise in Futility
14 - The Definition of Insanity
15 - The Inner Circle of Hell
• Added new enemies to appear on the new difficulties
• Added a new stratagem, MGX-42 Machine Gun. A disposable one use machine gun with very high fire rate. Unlockable on the new difficulties.

Fixed:
• The Shredder Missile stratagem is once again obtainable through planetary unlocks
• The AC-22 Dum-Dum magazines now disappear when on the ground
• LAS-98 Laser Cannon audio no longer repeats when firing quick bursts
• The fast reload mechanic now works as intended

Changed:
• Lowered the cooldown of the "Thunderer" Smoke Round Mk3
• Increased the number of uses for A/GL-8 Launcher Turret from 2 to 3

Liberty Day is here and new equipment from Super Earth has arrived!
• Added the Heavy Strafing Run Stratagem.
• Added the 'Thunderer' Smoke Round Stratagem.
• Added the A/GL-8 Launcher Turret Stratagem.
Added the M1b 'Next-Gen' armour and helmet.

New content
• Added the M2016 ‘Constitution’, a bolt action rifle used for ceremonial purposes. While not recommended to bring into the field, it is certainly possible to use for the very skilled or the very brave.
• Added the Liberty cape in celebration of Liberty Day!
• Added the Community cape, can be presented by the developers to outstanding individuals in the community.
• Added the Developer cape, now you can recognize the devs in the wild.

Fixes
• Fixed an issue where you regained sprint stamina while meleeing. The sprint-melee spam technique should no longer work.
• Fixed an issue where the convoy objective would travel into an obelisk wall before it was formed causing it to be destroyed instantly. Walls should now stop before hitting the convoy just like other objectives.
• Fixed an issue with a white rectangle flickering in the character customization screen.
• Fixed the statistic bars of the AT-47 to better represent the actual upgrades.

Balance changes
• The AT-47 now has 5 less ammunition without upgrades and 10 more when upgraded with Mk3. The result is that a fully upgraded AT-47 will have 5 more shots than before.
• The LAS-13 ‘Trident’ has had its damage lowered, it was overperforming previously.
• The LAS-16 ‘Sickle’ has had it’s damage lowered very slightly.
• Fixed an issue where samples were sometimes not awarded after mission completion.
